_readme: Attested MANUAL deploys — the traceability record for a deploy that shipped outside its lane.
check-prod-provenance.mjs accepts an entry ONLY after validating it against two independent
machine records: the sha must be a real commit on this repository (GitHub API), and a GitHub
Deployment written by record-deployment.mjs must exist for that sha+environment. An entry that
fails either check FAILS the run — a bad attestation is worse than an unattributed row.
Every accepted entry prints on every run. This register exists because run numbers are never
reissued: a manual restore that reuses a failed run number is version-monotonic but
⚠️ NARROWED 2026-08-09, AND THE ENTRIES BELOW ARE DELIBERATELY NOT DELETED. check-prod-provenance.mjs
now resolves a build automatically when its run number belongs to a run of ANY conclusion whose head
commit matches, AND a GitHub Deployment exists for that commit on a served environment — the same two
witnesses, read from the machine record instead of typed here. So the IN-LANE case (1.0.144, a deploy
that succeeded before a later step failed) no longer needs an entry, and deploy-web.yml now writes that
Deployment whenever the deploy step succeeded rather than only when the smoke passed. What still needs
an entry is a deploy that happened OUTSIDE any lane run at all. The rows below stay because they carry
the WHY — a machine witness says a thing shipped and never says why a human had to ship it that way.

deploys.why: deploy-web rail down since #185 (out=$(...) under bash -e dies before the already-exists tolerance); manual restore of merged main, full lane replica (version 132, artifact smoke, pages deploy, post-deploy smoke, GitHub Deployment record). Run 132 had failed, so the number resolves to no successful run — this attestation carries the traceability instead.

IN-lane deploy whose RUN reads failure: deploy-web run 144's 'Deploy to Cloudflare Pages' step succeeded at 16:08:58Z, then the post-deploy smoke gave up 51s later while the CDN still propagated — so 'Record the deployed SHA' skipped and the run went red AFTER the bundle shipped. The build genuinely served: a real visitor's consent artifact (granted=1) + 2 events carry 1.0.144+40c0787 at 2026-08-08T16:50Z, and runs 145/146 were concurrency-cancelled so nothing replaced it until later. The rows are a real person's, not residue; this attestation carries their traceability. Deployment witness recorded retroactively 2026-08-09.
